#  44507 - Master Thesis Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **44507 - module is no longer offered from SS 2015**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Master Thesis**  |  
|  Master-Arbeit   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Mauß, Fabian 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  On special announcement   |  
| Credits:  |  30   |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Realization of a research or engineering project in the area of process safety, process risk analysis or design/optimization of process plant  |  
| Contents:  | Actual theoretical and/or experimental topics are:- Hydrogen production plants: plant design, plant control, process risk analysis (reformer, electrolyser)- Process safety: determination of operation limits (reactor, distillation unit)- Process risk analysis: multi objective optimization  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | At the time of issue of the master thesis, the student must have at least acquired 78 credit points from the fundamental modules, central and elective modules, interdisciplinary modules, etc.  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Research paper/essay / 900 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Basic literature will be given.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Written report: 0,75%, Presentation und Disputation: 0,25%.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | time: 5 Month  |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
